Are you ready to explore the world of aerospace and defense? Do you want to learn from and collaborate with some of the greatest minds in the industry? What You Will Do

In Systems Engineering and Test Capabilities (SE&TC) we integrate, verify, and validate our products. We put our systems together, exercise them in the lab or in the field, measure and analyze performance, and make sure our products work the first time and every time. To accomplish this, we develop plans and procedures, debug and evaluate system functions and interfaces, develop test environments, and work hand-in-hand with our customers.

Our Integrated Systems Team seeks interns to support integration and test of hardware and software of complex air defense systems. Our team provides system engineering, integration, and test expertise to the radar, missile, and ground system programs within Raytheon. In this role you will perform various engineering activities depending on your experience and skill level, such as system test requirements development, planning, execution, and analysis for system integration and verification in hardware-in-the-loop facilities, flight tests, and sell-off of production systems; technical support on-site and as reach-back for deployed sensor systems; and modeling and simulation.

- Experience in data analysis using tools such as MATLAB

The Opportunity:

Procter & Gamble Beauty Care Global Product Stewardship is looking for a PhD student Intern to help build the data foundation needed to scale life cycle assessment (LCA) across Beauty Care. You will develop and organize life cycle inventory data, turning information from different sources and formats into consistent, model-ready datasets to enable Beauty Care business to generate sustainability insights more efficiently and use life cycle thinking in product and portfolio decisions, supporting P&G climate goals.

The Ideal Candidate Has:

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail and a practical approach to complex technical data.
- Interest in and comfort with working with incomplete or ambiguous information and turning it into clear, consistent data structures.
- Strong communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain technical work to different audiences.
- Good organizational skills and a disciplined approach to documenting assumptions, methods, and decisions.

Key Responsibilities

- Identify and fill important life cycle inventory (LCI) data gaps and clearly document assumptions, data quality, and sources.
- Organize unstructured and semi-structured cosmetic-industry LCI data into standardized formats that can support scalable LCA workflows.
- Develop practical approaches for cleaning, harmonizing, versioning, and maintaining data over time.
- Test the structured data in selected Beauty Care products for scalability.
- Look for ways to simplify data transfer into LCA tools and recommend improvements that could support future automation.
- Work with data covering product formulation, raw materials, packaging, manufacturing, distribution, and consumer use, as needed.
- Capture key learnings that can support broader use of the approach across Beauty Care sector and other business units in P&G.

Required Qualifications:

- Currently pursuing a PhD in Environmental Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Ecology, Sustainability Science, Data Science, or a related field with a focus on life cycle assessment, environmental modeling, product sustainability, or data management.
- Understanding of LCA principles, including cradle-to-grave modeling, life cycle inventory data, and environmental impact indicators.
- Experience organizing, cleaning, and harmonizing structured and unstructured technical data.
- Ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary teams.
- Available to work a 12-week internship from May/early June to August in the summer of 2027. Ability to work onsite 4-5 days a week in office at our Mason location.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Familiarity with LCA software and databases such as SimaPro, GaBi, openLCA, or ecoinvent.
- Experience using Python, Databricks, SQL, or similar tools for data analysis.
- Familiarity with data quality, metadata, traceability, and version-control practices.
- Interest in consumer products, eco-design, digital sustainability, or scalable environmental assessment.

What We Offer

- Meaningful work from Day 1 – You will take ownership of a real business challenge by providing clear technical input to support climate goals, with the opportunity to influence how LCA data are managed and used.
- Mentorship and learning – You will work closely with experienced technical leaders and receive regular coaching throughout the internship.
- Visible business impact – Your work will enable Beauty Care teams make faster, better-informed product and portfolio decisions.
- A collaborative environment – You will work across disciplines and build practical experience in LCA, data management, digital workflows, and technical communication.
